notes.title: Performances improvements
notes.content:
here is a list of changes for the update
[list]
[*] Some unreachable building in the New Wish city have been fixed
[*] Added some bedskips in new wish city
[*] Now, setting "View distance quality to low" drastically improves performances
[/list]

notes.title: Only Wish 1.0 release!
notes.content:
We are proud to announce the official release of Only Wish on steam! We can't wait to see how you are going to defeat mr mysterious 👻

There may still have a lot of bugs in the game, if that's the case, feel free to get in touch with us on discord or twitch and we will fix it asap!

[h2]Our plans for the future[/h2]
We hope that you will enjoy playing it as much as we loved making it and plan to make new updates to add:
[list]
[*] new localizations
[*] performances enchancments
[*] bug fixes
[*] and of course implement your wonderful suggestions!
[/list]

[i][b]see you soon in New Wish City 💯[/b][/i]
